Paychex HR Analytics With AI Insights

Workforce data can be difficult to utilize when teams have to navigate reports, filters, and specialized analytics tools. In this video, see how Paychex HR Analytics and Reporting with AI Insights lets users easily ask workforce questions, surface relevant metrics and trends, and compare workforce data with benchmarks for similar businesses, industries, and regions. Explore additional Paychex Flex demos to see other capabilities across the platform. For broader context, learn more about AI for People Analytics or how Paychex uses AI across payroll and HR.

Introduction to HR Analytics With AI Insights

0:03 Gathering effective insights from workforce data is difficult. Even knowing where to start demands skill and experience. But what if you could do so without needing a data analyst? Introducing HR Analytics with AI Insights in Paychex Flex.

Ask Workforce Questions in Natural Language

0:22 It empowers you to make business decisions based on data no matter your skill level. Say goodbye to digging through endless reports and filters. Instead, you’ll be able to access insights by asking questions phrased in your own words.

Explore Workforce Analytics Conversationally

0:38 Exploring your HR analytics is as simple as having a conversation.

Compare Workforce Data With Benchmarks

0:42 Compare your data to other businesses in your region, your industry, and of similar size. How are we performing is no longer something you have to try to answer in a vacuum.

Use Workforce Insights To Support Planning

0:55 Navigate success by comparing your company to millions of aggregated data points.

Data Security and Decision Support

1:01 Security is paramount, so you can rest assured that your data will remain safe. And you can protect the effects of today’s decisions into the future, helping you feel more secure in your decision making.

Try HR Analytics With AI Insights

1:15 Drop the SQL queries and BI dashboards. Contact us today to try HR Analytics with AI Insights. What will you ask first?

Turn Workforce Data Into Actionable Insights

Explore Paychex HR Analytics and Reporting, including AI Insights, workforce benchmarks, forecasting, guided analyses, and reporting options designed to help businesses understand workforce trends.
